name: std::atomic_ref<T>::operator=
intro:
1) Equivalent to store(desired); return desired;. This overload participates in overload resolution only if std::is_const_v<T> is false.

2) atomic_ref is not CopyAssignable.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Unlike most assignment operators, the assignment operator for atomic_ref does not return a reference to its left-hand argument. It returns a copy of the stored value instead.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: A shared counter starts at 4, then receives 8, 10, and 12.
